maria: Quick sync — CloudLoom marketplace listing + integration blog + joint webinar. We need a concrete launch choreography and inbound routing plan. Who can own what? :spiral_calendar:
sara: I can draft the integration post and own the webinar script. Need screenshots + a small code snippet from eng to show the auth flow.jasper: I9ll take partner comms and the marketplace listing checklist. They want a co-branded hero, 2 logo variants, and a 60s demo clip. Can we commit to assets by Mon?oliver: I9ll produce the demo clip if I get a script and test creds. Also need the list of endpoints to demo (auth, sample request/response).rachel: For the benchmark narrative, propose one slide focused on latency and cost-per-1k comparison vs baseline + a one-paragraph customer vignette.leo: Inbound routing plan: tag all leads with campaign=CLDLM_LAUNCH_2026_04_08; partner-sourced leads should set lead_source=partner_cloudloom and flow to SDR pool B. I9ll also expose a webhook for partner lead pushes.maria: Asset deadlines proposed: logos + hero by Mon EOD, demo script by Wed, blog draft by Thu, webinar slides by next Mon. Agree?jasper: Yes. I9ll push existing logos to /shared/brand-assets and ask partner for the co-branded hero. If partner delays, we use our dev assets.sara: Blog structure I'm planning: 1) Partnership why (value prop), 2) Integration walkthrough (with curl snippet), 3) Performance & cost highlights (embed rachel9s chart), 4) CTA to marketplace listing & webinar signup.oliver: Draft curl snippet for blog (minimal):```\
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1.2","input":"summarize logs"}'
```jasper: Webinar structure request from partner: co-host intro (5m) + 10m live demo + 20m panel Q&A + 10m customer case. Total ~45m. Can we staff two hosts?maria: Sara will moderate; Oliver will run the demo. Jasper will handle partner introductions and co-host logistics.leo: Landing page + tracking: I9ll spin up a dedicated LP at /partners/cloudloom-launch with utm params utm_source=cloudloom&utm_campaign=CLDLM_LAUNCH_2026_04_08. Will also create SFDC campaign and a webhook mapping spec. Webhook example for ops:```
POST /webhooks/mktg
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "lead_email": "...",
  "campaign": "CLDLM_LAUNCH_2026_04_08",
  "partner": "cloudloom"
}
```rachel: Benchmarks note: I9ll run the latency & cost runs by Thu and produce one chart plus a short one-sentence takeaway. If partner has a customer quote, we9ll swap in later.maria: Ops asks: product/dev, can you guarantee a test tenant + API key for Oliver by Fri morning? Also need three screenshots from the UI for the blog (integration settings, success flow, logs).oliver: Need a test tenant, API key, and a stable sample dataset. If product can provide a temp key and a sandbox, I9ll record Wed/Thu.jasper: Partner requested a short 60s cut of the demo for the marketplace listing and social. Oliver9s team to deliver final MP4; Jasper will collect B-roll from partner if available.sara: For the blog code sample, we should keep auth simple (API key) and show a concise example. I9ll post a draft into #marketing-drafts by Thu EOD.maria: Budget & promotion — Leo: recommend $3.5k paid social plus partner newsletter placement. Also ask cloud marketplace to pin the listing for the first week if possible.leo: Noted. I9ll set campaign budgets and coordinate ad creative with Jasper. Will also add funnel tracking: form submits -> mark as MQL if company_size > 50 and opens > 1.rachel: On narrative, recommend we emphasize cost savings from batch inference and the seamless auth flow. One benchmark slide + two bullets is enough for the blog and webinar.maria: Action owner summary: jasper=partner assets & marketplace listing; sara=integration blog + webinar moderation; oliver=demo video + recordings; rachel=benchmarks slide; leo=inbound routing + LP + SFDC campaign. Checkpoint: next Tue 10am PT to review final assets. :checkered_flag:
jasper: Sending partner comms now and cc-ing legal for co-brand approvals.sara: Draft outline uploaded to #marketing-drafts; pinging when ready for review.leo: SFDC campaign created (ID: C-CLDLM-0426) and landing page skeleton up. Sharing webhook spec in this thread shortly.oliver: Recording rig queued. Will need final script by Wed morning.maria: Thanks all — if any blockers surface, post here. We9ll run a quick stand at 9am PT Mon if anything is still outstanding. :raised_hands:
